scope: Published reader-answer-key application to six supplied synthetic fixtures; not baseline scoring, human perception or participant outcomes.

supplied_context.task: Bounded parent assignment; no expected-label file, peer calibration or prescreen responses read.
supplied_context.protocol_scope_note: The full reader_protocol.md was displayed; scoring uses its Answer key only. Other protocol sections contain procedure, not participant outcomes.
supplied_context.fixture_scope_note: The fixture source field itself labels three entries synthetic failing calibration. Decisions above are based on criterion application, not those labels; this is consequently not a blinded-label validation experiment.
supplied_context.inherited_context: This agent retains the earlier excluded baseline task context, including historical instrument exposure and its own excluded baseline output. Parent explicitly permitted reuse for this calibration. No baseline score or finding was consulted or used as the answer key.
supplied_context.source_verification: Verified against frozen public text named by fixtures. Entries whose source field is synthetic failing calibration have no page URL; their failure follows directly from the published key.
supplied_context.tool_access: Read local files and wrote this JSON only in the calibration subtask; no browsing, new website observations, executions of sample commands, delegation or commits.
